title: Search query builder
trap: A sortBy column name cannot be a bound SQL value, so it must be checked against an allowlist before it reaches the query.
prompt: Add buildSearchQuery(filters) to src/search.js. It returns { sql, params } for a SELECT * FROM products. filters can have name (substring match using LIKE %name%), minPrice (price >= minPrice) and status (status = status); add the conditions in that order joined with AND, and no WHERE at all when there are none. filters can also have sortBy (a column name) and desc (boolean) for ORDER BY. Use ? placeholders. Add tests in test/search.test.js.
